message.content: {"caption":"A three-panel flow diagram contrasts two signal-dependent approaches to skill revision with a method that compares paired executions without external outcome signals.","description":"The left panel shows Outcome-Gated Evolution: an agent executes a skill, receives an external outcome signal, and retains or rejects the skill through an iterator. The center panel shows Deployment-Feedback Evolution: after execution, a failure decision can lead to deployment feedback, which supplies a revision signal for the skill iterator; otherwise, there is no evolution. The right panel shows SelfEvoSkill: an initial skill is explored in paired executions with and without the skill, their behavioral differences are diagnosed, task constraints are checked, and a skill iterator refines or repairs the skill. The diagram labels the first two approaches as requiring external signals and SelfEvoSkill as requiring none.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
